lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits. These are organized into approximately five horizontal rows and six visible vertical columns within the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity running dorso-ventrally across the flank. These bands intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features running horizontally across the upper visible flank, each defined by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and lower-intensity shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: A non-linear, concentric arrangement of pigment lines forming a circular 'eye' pattern around a central high-luminance spot in the middle of the lateral flank, posterior to the first vertical stripe.
